meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: Claude 可通过 lsp 工具获取代码诊断、定位定义、查找引用、浏览符号,并检查或执行安全重命名。
howto.when: 当你需要检查代码错误、查找定义或引用,或进行重命名安全检查时触发。

say.text: 检查这个项目里的 TypeScript 错误
say.note: 会运行 lsp.diagnostics 查看诊断信息

say.text: 跳转到 main 函数的定义
say.note: 使用 goto_definition 定位定义

say.text: 把变量 count 重命名为 total,安全吗?
say.note: 先执行 prepare_rename 检查再重命名

howto.what_en: Claude can use lsp tools to get code diagnostics, locate definitions, find references, inspect symbols, and check or perform safe renames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need code diagnostics, definitions, references, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

say_en.text: Check TypeScript errors in this project.
Jump to the definition of main function.
Is it safe to rename variable count to total?
